title: Ten Words, Ninety-Nine Numbers
label: ch:zh-decimal
canDo: I can build any number from eleven to ninety-nine out of the ten words I already have, say a hundred, and read a price written in Arabic numerals.

payoff.summary: One rule of order turns ten words into ninety-nine numbers, 一百 is where 一's tone finally moves, and the digits chapter says which of 5 and 五 a price tag actually prints.
